description: This file defines a generic class TransactionCommitter<TService> responsible for managing transaction commits within an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes methods for participating in lifecycle events, handling commit operations, and maintains internal state related to transaction management and logging.

classes.name: TransactionCommitter`1
classes.description: A generic class responsible for managing transaction commit operations, including participating in the lifecycle, handling commit requests, and maintaining transaction state.

classes.name: TransactionCommitter`1.OperationState
classes.description: A serializable class representing the state of a transaction operation, including the operation details.

classes.name: TransactionCommitter`1.DateTimeLogRecord
classes.description: A readonly struct for logging DateTime values in a standardized string format.

methods.name: OnCommit
methods.description: Handles a commit operation within the transaction, performing necessary locking, copying, and recording of operation state.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the committer to lifecycle events to initialize transaction state and resources.

methods.name: OnSetupState
methods.description: Initializes the transaction committer's state, including creating storage, setting up processing queues, and restoring prior state.
